title: Pre-built workflow templates
description: Create 3 built-in workflow templates (chapter pipeline, revision pass, style analysis) with builtin- prefix. These are embedded as constants in the service and merged with user workflows on load.
action: Add builtinWorkflows constant array to workflowService.ts containing 3 pre-built Workflow objects with builtin- prefixed IDs: builtin-chapter-pipeline, builtin-revision-pass, builtin-style-analysis. Each has 3-5 steps with appropriate agentModes and prompts.

criteria: workflowService.ts contains builtinWorkflows array with 3 entries
builtin-chapter-pipeline has ≥3 steps: outline review (analysis), draft writing (writing), revision (writing)
builtin-revision-pass has ≥3 steps: content analysis (analysis), targeted revision (writing), consistency check (evaluation)
builtin-style-analysis has ≥3 steps: style extraction (analysis), comparison (analysis), recommendations (evaluation)
loadWorkflows() merges builtin templates with user workflows
convergence.verification: npx tsc --noEmit exits 0; builtinWorkflows array contains 3 valid Workflow objects
convergence.definition_of_done: 3 built-in workflow templates embedded in service, merged with user workflows on load

files.change: Add builtinWorkflows array with 3 pre-built Workflow definitions, update loadWorkflows to prepend them

implementation: Define builtinWorkflows: Workflow[] constant in workflowService.ts

Create builtin-chapter-pipeline: { id: 'builtin-chapter-pipeline', name: 'Chapter Pipeline', steps: [outline review (analysis, checkpoint: review), draft writing (writing, checkpoint: review), final revision (writing, checkpoint: approve)], isBuiltin: true }

Create builtin-revision-pass: { id: 'builtin-revision-pass', name: 'Revision Pass', steps: [content analysis (analysis, checkpoint: none), targeted revision (writing, checkpoint: review), consistency check (evaluation, checkpoint: approve)], isBuiltin: true }

Create builtin-style-analysis: { id: 'builtin-style-analysis', name: 'Style Analysis', steps: [style extraction (analysis, checkpoint: none), comparison (analysis, checkpoint: review), recommendations (evaluation, checkpoint: approve)], isBuiltin: true }
Update loadWorkflows to prepend builtinWorkflows before user-loaded workflows
Ensure saveWorkflow rejects saves for builtin- prefixed IDs

success_metrics: Templates compile and contain valid Workflow objects with correct step configurations

reference.pattern: Follow templateService.ts builtin- prefix pattern for built-in items

rationale.chosen_approach: 3 templates match brainstorm spec requirements and demonstrate all agent modes (writing, analysis, evaluation)
decision_factors: Chapter pipeline is the primary use case from F-007 spec
Revision pass demonstrates multi-step writing workflow
Style analysis showcases analysis + evaluation agent modes
